_comment_paypal_creds: client-id, client-secret, and tunnel-url come from docker/.env (PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID / PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET / PAYPAL_TUNNEL_URL), resolved by application.yml. Don't put real PayPal creds or your ngrok tunnel here — this file is checked into git.
_comment_mock_paypal: Local mock toggle: to use mock-paypal-service instead of real PayPal, set application.paypal.base-url to http://localhost:8585/mock-paypal-service AND set PAYPAL_TUNNEL_URL in docker/.env to http://localhost:6868 (local gateway port from scripts/services.list), then run: make vault-import (or re-import) and restart payment-service. NOTE: mock-paypal-service targets Java 25, so run make up with JAVA_HOME pointing at a JDK 25 (it also runs the Java-17 services).
